judgement.reason: The production image is a single app; the PostgREST, Redis and multi-service setup can be handled with contained changes and settings, so the outcome is not too lenient.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unsupported architecture: docker-compose.yaml defines 3 application services (plugins, client, server). Deployz runs ONE web process per deployment plus declared background workers.
reviews.reason: The docker-compose.yaml services are a development stack built from .dev Dockerfiles, while production uses the single docker/ce-production.Dockerfile that builds plugins, frontend and server into one image.

reviews.findingEvidence: Unconfirmed service: the repository declares redis (redis:7-alpine) in docker-compose.yaml. Deployz did not find how the application uses it.
reviews.reason: The declared service is Redis, which Deployz provides as single-node Redis, and the server selects it through the REDIS_HOST setting.
